text:
What is a machine able to do when trained properly by a human scientist?

In this lesson, you will use the ML model to identify earthquakes in the same data you looked at yesterday. First, let's find one earthquake signal in the data to see how it works.

Instructions

1) In the WaveRunner Tile, choose any station around Anchorage.

2) Set the "Model" dropdown to "Compact model"

3) Set the start date as November 29, 2018 at 12:00 am

4) Set the end date as December 1, 2018 at 12:00 am

5) Click the Play button in the bottom control bar.

6) Click the "Timeline It!" button in the bottom control bar.

7) Explore the data in the timeline to identify an earthquake event
